newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady $106/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady $106/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a limited test, USDA said. Buyer inquiry was only fair and seller interest minimal as the vast majority have already traded their showlists.
Wk To Date- 104,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 51,700 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 35,600
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs -
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs -
For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis were $0.50-$1.00 higher; dressed basis mostly $1.00 higher. The week's total includes 6,300 previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
